Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates sharply demarcated, thin-walled cystic cavities with air-fluid levels located in the left lower lobe (retrocardiac region), which is the classic radiographic presentation of an infected intralobar pulmonary sequestration. Other options are inconsistent with the specific morphology (thin-walled vs thick-walled) or location (left lower lobe vs right upper lobe) of the lesions shown.
